clips.title: The story
paras: Mining Consultant is a Northshire Valley quest that sends adventurers to confer with Kelsey Fargo, a mining apprentice stationed outside Echo Ridge Mine. Her observations reveal an unusual development: the local kobolds have begun plundering books from Northshire Abbey's library.

The kobold infestation at Echo Ridge Mine has taken an unexpected turn. Rather than merely defending subterranean claims and gathering candles, the creatures have caught the attention of local authorities due to strange, coordinated disturbances. Adventurers are directed to seek out Kelsey Fargo, a mining apprentice stationed near the mine's entrance, to ascertain what she has witnessed from her vantage point outside the tunnels.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
